newsitem.title: albania: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Durres - Jan 7 - Ten vessels discharging of which 3 wheat flour, 1 sugar, 1 rice, 1 railway equipment, 1 nitrates, 1 soft drinks/mineral water, 1 potatoes, 1 bulk cement. 1 Vessel loading phosphate. Vessels awaiting berth in roads for discharging, 1 steel products, 1 bagged cement, 1 wheat, 1 nitrates, 2 wheat flour, 1 rice/electrodes, 1 electrodes.

BULGARIA, Jan 6 - Varna - East - 7 Vessels loadiing at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 5 awaiting orders. West - 10 vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bourgas - East - 19 Vessels due, 11 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 10 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 7 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 vessels under repair/dry-dock. West - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 tanker in port.

Bourgas - 32 Vessels operating of which 22 loading, 1 equipment, 1 cigarettes, 5 ammonia nitrate, 3 ammonia sulphate, 1 frozen chicken, 1 paper, 2 containers, 1 clinker, 6 steel, 1 cars, 1 copper concentrates. 7 Discharging, 1 salt, 1 copper concentrates, 1 iron ore, 1 sugar, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 petrol, 1 oil. 3 Vessels discharging/loading, 1 concentrates/copper, 1 containers/general, 1 salt/general. 18 Vessels waiting in roads of which 10 to load, 1 cars, 2 steel, 3 chemicals, 1 oil, 1 cases, 1 metal, 1 copper concentrates. 6 To discharge, 1 sugar, 1 rails, 1 oil, 1 copper concentrates, 1 coal. 1 Discharging/loading copper/general, 1 cargo not nominated.

Varna - 23 Vessels operating of which 13 loading, 1 cement, 2 clinker, 1 sas, 1 containers, 1 plywood, 1 edc, 5 soda, 1 urea. 5 Discharging, 1 coke, 1 trucks/containers, 1 phosphorite, 1 coal, 1 frozen chicken. 5 Discharging/loading, 4 containers, 1 trucks/containers. 14 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 to load, 1 tsp, 2 scrap, 2 urea, 1 sas. 2 To discharge, 1 rice, 1 coal. 6 Cargo not nominated.

ESTONIA, Jan 6 - Tallinn - City port - 5 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 map, 1 timber), 1 vessel discharging cocoa beans at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 liner vessel. Kopli - 7 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading sawn timber at berth, 2 vessels discharging at berth (1 meat, 1 beans). Muuga - No information available. Parnu - 6 Vessels due, no delays expected. 7 Vessels loading at berth (4 timber, 2 boards, 1 briquette).

ITALY, Jan 7 - Naples - Vessels berthed, 1 ro/ro, 1 gas tanker, 1 bulk carrier to berth in the next few days. Gaeta - One bulker carrier to berth 10/1 or 11/1. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - Six vessels in roads, 43 berthed, 2 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - Two vessels in roads, 3 vessels berthed. Savona, Vado Ligure, Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Trieste - No vessels in roads, no delays. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 8 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Nine vessels in roads, 41 berthed. Augusta oil harbour, Syracuse - No delays. Sarroch - One vessel in roads, 2 berthed. Taranto, Ravenna - No delays. Ancona/Falconara - Two vessels in roads. Bad weather. Venice - No vessels in roads.

LATVIA, Jan - Ventspils - Five vessels operating of which 3 steel loaders, 1 mop loader, 1 steel/steel billets, no delays. 6 Vessels due. Riga - 12 Vessels operating of which 4 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loaders, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 tanker loader, 1 steel loader, 1 fish discharger, 1 oranges discharger, no delays. 16 Vessels due. Liepaja - 11 Vessels in port of which 8 operating, 3 awaiting operations, no delays, 1 vessel due.
LITHUANIA, Jan 6 Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 general cargo, 3 fertiliser, 3 steel coils, 1 ingots, 1 other. Vessels discharging, 2 fish, 1 soya pellets, 1 corns. 3 Vessels in roads, 20 due.

POLAND, Jan 7 - Szczecin - 63 Vessels due, delays expected. 31 Vessels loading at berth, 30 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 under repair/drydock, 2 awaiting orders. Gdynia - 15 Vessels operating. 3 General cargo loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth (1 bulk, 5 general cargo, 3 grain, 3 coal). 4 Vessels under repair/drydock, 28 due. Gdansk - 12 Vessels operating, 3 awaiting turn (2 coal, 1 bulk). 8 Loading at berth (3 bulk, 3 general cargo, 2 coal), 4 discharging grain at berth, 3 vessels under repairs, 16 due.

PORTUGAL, Jan 6 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 7 general cargo, 3 container vessels, no vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant, 6 piers with cranes, 1 pier without cranes. Jan 7 - Sines - Vessels operating, 1 discharging coal, 1 loading butane/propane, 1 loading metallic structures. Vessels waiting, 1 to discharge coal, 1 to load propylene, 1 to load cargo. Vessels due, 2 to discharge coal, 1 to discharge crude oil, 1 to load propylene. Setubal - Vessels in port, 3 loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth. Vessels due, 5 for discharging, 3 for loading, 2 under repair/drydock. ROMANIA, Jan 6 - Constantza - 69 Vessels operating of which 32 generals (24 loading, 8 discharging), 14 bagged chemicals (13 loading, 1 discharging), 12 bulkers (5 loading, 7 discharging), 2 bagged cement loading, 2 tankers discharging, 2 loading, 3 container vessels loading, 2 container vessels discharging. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 bulkers, 2 generals, 1 container vessel for loading and discharging. Constantza sud (Agigea) - 11 Vessels loading in port. Mangalia - One general cargo loading. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading, no vessels waiting.

RUSSIA, Jan 6 - FAR EAST PORTS - Vladivostok - 14 Vessels in port of which 2 passenger vessels. 6 Vessels loading (1 container, 4 metal, 1 timber), 1 discharging rice, 5 waiting. Nakhodka - 15 Vessels in port of which 12 loading (3 metal, 5 timber, 2 general cargo, 2 cotton). 3 Vessels waiting. Vostochniy - 12 Vessels in port of which 8 loanding (4 timber, 2 containers, 2 coal), 1 discharging cars, 3 waiting. Posyet - One loading ore. Zarubino - Two vessels loading of which 1 timber, 1 metal. No delays, strikes or congestion in ports.

BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 23 Vessels operating of which loading 7 non-ferrous, 1 timber, 2 containers, 4 fertiliser, 2 cellulose, 1 general/ discharging, 1 bagged rice, 2 frozen meat, 1 container vessel, 2 frozen chicken. 5 Vessels awaiting operations, 13 due. Kaliningrad - Seven vessels operating of which 1 alumina loader, 1 metal loader, 3 urea loaders, 1 coal loader, 1 sugar discharger. No delays, 2 vessels due. Vyborg - Six vessels operating, no delays, 4 vessels due.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Eight vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 anode paste, 1 coal, 1 apatite loader, 3 alumina dischargers waiting. 13 Vessels due during the week of which 8 loaders (2 apatite, 1 scrap, 1 cabotage, 2 non-ferrous metals, 2 iron ore pellets). 5 Dischargers (3 alumina, 2 cabotage).

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 16 Vessels operating of which 11 loading 1 general, 1 coal, 1 scrap, 3 steel, 1 aluminium, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 urea, 1 cellulose, 1 seeds. 5 Discharging 2 citrus, 1 rice, 1 sugar, 1 bananas. 20 Vessels waiting in roads of which 14 to load, 4 steel, 1 steel/paper, 1 aluminium, 4 scrap, 1 pipes, 1 barley, 1 coal, 1 zinc concentrates. 6 To discharge 1 sugar, 3 rice, 1 alumium, 1 baryte oxide. 30 Vessels due of which 24 to load 1 scrap, 12 steel, 2 copper cathodes, 2 cellulose, 1 paper, 1 grain, 1 hydrofoils, 1 urea, 1 salt petre, 1 molasses, 1 wire. 6 To discharge, 1 rice, 3 citrus, 1 containers. Oil terminal, Jan 7 - 2 Tankers loading crude, 7 tankers due to load of which 6 crude oil, 1 diesel.

SLOVENIA, Jan 6 - Koper - 14 Vessels berthed of which 3 containers loading/discharging, 2 bulk carriers discharging alumina/soda, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 1 livestock loading bulls, 3 general cargo loading rails/paper/genral cargo, 1 general cargo discharging sugar, 2 ferries loading/discharging, 1 car carrier discharging cars. 9 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 2 car carriers to load and discharge cars, 1 bulk carrier to discharge coal, 1 livestock to load bulls, 3 container vessels to load/discharge, 2 general cargo to load paper/sawn timber. No delays expected.

SPAIN, Jan 7 - Aviles - Seven vessels in port of which 4 loading (1 zinc, 2 steel products, 1 pieces). 3 Discharging (1 al, 1 steel, 1 alumina). Gijon - Seven vessels in port of which 4 loading (1 sugar, 1 cement, 2 steel products). 3 Discharging (1 coal, 1 cement, 1 profiles). Stevedores strike still in force, except during the weekend. Cadiz - 15 Vessels operating of which 4 ro/ro, 1 semolina, 2 shipbuilding material, 1 clinker, 7 repairs, no delays.

TURKEY, Jan 7 - Mersin - 11 Vessels awaiting orders. 20 Vessels operating of which loading, 3 citrus, 1 container vessel, 2 chickpeas, 1 general cargo, 1 cement, 1 pipes, 6 bales, 1 glass. Discharging, 1 jute, 1 sugar, 1 pyrites, 2 general cargo. Loading/discharging, 1 iron/pipes, 3 container vessels. Free zone piers - 1 vessel discharging sugar. Seka - No vessels in port.

UKRAINE, Jan 4 - Mariupol - 14 Vessels loading at berth, (fertiliser, metal products, sunflower seeds, sulphur, containers), 2 discharging at berth (alumina and fluorspar). 7 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (metal products, urea, sunflowerseeds), 9 floating houses (metal products, fertiliser, sulphur). 1 Vessel under repair. 22 Vessels due (sulphur, fertiliser, urea, sunflower seeds, metal products, coal, pvc, fluorspar, containers, general cargo).

Jan 5 - Odessa - 23 Vessels operating of which 9 loading, 3 sunflowerseeds, 1 fertiliser, 5 metal. 5 Discharging, 1 rice, 1 citrus, 1 bananas, 1 petrol, 1 container vessel. 1 Discharging/loading containers. 3 Vessels under repair, 1 waiting, 4 passenger vessels in port. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load, 2 sunflowerseeds, 1 oil. 2 To discharge, 1 bananas, 1 citrus. 18 Vessels due of which 12 to load, 8 metals, 2 sunflower seeds, 2 chemicals. 3 To discharge, 1 general, 1 containers, 1 rice. 2 To discharge/load containers. 1 Cargo not nominated.
